name: Grid Row Delete — Parked-Index Variant (preferred)
description: Row delete with a confirm dialog, where the target row index is parked in a scratch dataset BEFORE the dialog opens and read back from there when YES is clicked. Prefer this over molecule.grid-row-action-delete: that version reads [this.propkey] inside the dialog's own whenclick, which only works while the row context happens to survive. This version is context-independent and also recalculates totals after the delete.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 3.9 (line-items grid — parked index + calcformula), PART 5.2 (additional-amount grid — direct [this.propkey], no recalc)

indexDataset.description: Scratch dataset holding the row index. Observed: "dscurListIndex".

trailingFormula.description: e.g. "[calcformula]" — ALWAYS include this when the grid feeds a total.

rules: nodeepprocess:true on the dialoginfo setdataset is MANDATORY — it stores the YES button's action list raw instead of resolving it while the dialog is being built. Without it, [dscurListIndex] and [calcformula] resolve too early.
Because the nested list resolves at click time, [this.propkey] CANNOT be used inside it — there is no row context then. Hence the parked index.
btn2 needs no props at all: {"chld":"NO"} is sufficient; the dialog just closes.
data:null at an index is how mergedatasetarray deletes a row.

ALWAYS append the trailing formula. The additional-amount grid in the source omits it and leaves the Summary stale after a delete — a real bug, recorded in examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md PART 11.
